newsitem.title: UK: London stocks open firmer, upside seen limited.
newsitem.headline: London stocks open firmer, upside seen limited.

text.p: UK shares opened mostly higher on Tuesday as a few tentative buyers pushed the FTSE back towards its all-time high point following Wall Street's 41-point advance on Monday.
But market nerves ahead of Federal Reserve chief Alan Greenspan's Humphey-Hawkins testimony on Wednesday and U.S. jobs numbers on Friday should put a cap on any near-term gains.
"Wall Street once again has come to the rescue but there are still a few minefields to cross before the week is out," the head of trading at a major investment bank said.
The FTSE 100 was up 15.2 points to 4,322.3 by 0831 GMT.
